definitions.explanation: A Japanese national holiday on the third Monday of September, dedicated to honoring elderly people and celebrating their longevity.

examples.japanese: {敬老|けいろう}の{日|ひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねた→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧。
examples.english: I visited my grandparents on Respect for the Aged Day.

examples.japanese: {敬老|けいろう}の{日|ひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}ろう→贈る：09862_okuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っている→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: I'm trying to decide what to give as a present for Respect for the Aged Day.

examples.japanese: {敬老|けいろう}の{日|ひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}いて→招く：02425_maneku⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集|つど}い→集い：14600_tsudoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: On Respect for the Aged Day, a gathering of appreciation is held inviting elderly people from the community.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{敬老|けいろう}の{日|ひ} is a national holiday (⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧) on the third Monday of September. It was established in 1966 to honor the elderly and celebrate long life. Many families visit grandparents and give gifts. Communities often hold special events for senior citizens.

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{敬老|けいろう}→敬老：16771_keirou⟧ means "respect for the elderly" and can be used in other compounds like ⟦{敬老|けいろう}→敬老：16771_keirou⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧ (spirit of respecting the elderly) and ⟦{敬老|けいろう}→敬老：16771_keirou⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (party honoring the elderly).
